purpose: Large visible-production integration pass that reuses every project-owned production family across the playable Part I runtime, increases environmental density without moving story topology, and keeps the external-license pipeline ready for future approved third-party assets.
cp52_integration_goals: Reuse the common production kit in Shire and Bree instead of limiting it to P1C03-P1C08.
Increase chapter-specific prop density with fences, wood piles, logs, path markers, foliage, reeds, bridges and ruin debris.
Make the first launch immediately produce P1C01, the active ShireArrival quest, the living-world director and the production world router.
Do not invent external-license approval: Data/ExternalAssetManifest.json currently has no approved asset entries.

external_resource_policy.rule: Third-party files enter runtime only after a real manifest asset entry and license evidence. Eight receipt/SHA256-verified Poly Haven P1C01 surface sources are now approved; all other third-party files remain gated.

implemented_by_cp52: shared common-kit saturation across Part I
playable startup path preserved and explicitly guarded
